arabic text: AAJA ASGHAR KI JAGA, MERI SAKINA SOJA
english translation text: COME IN PLACE OF ASGHAR, SLEEP O MY SAKINA

arabic text: AAJA ASGHAR KI JAGA, MERI SAKINA SOJA\nJAAGTI MAA NAI KAHA, MERI SAKINA SOJA
english translation text: 'COME IN PLACE OF ASGHAR, SLEEP O MY SAKINA',\nSAID THE MOTHER OF SAKINA

arabic text: JO TUJHAY KHOF HAIN SHAYAD MAIN USAY KAM KARDOON\nAAJA AANKHON PAI TERAY NAAD-E-ALI DAM KARDOON\nDOOR KYUN BAITI HAI AA MERI SAKINA SOJA
english translation text: PERHAPS I MAY BE ABLE TO RELIEVE YOUR FEAR,\nLET ME RECITE NAD-E-ALI FOR YOU,\nWHY DO YOU SIT FAR AWAY, COME, SLEEP O MY SAKINA,

arabic text: BAAP KAI SEENAY PAI AADAT HAIN TUJHAY SONAY KI\nMERI GOUDI TERAY QAABIL KO NAHI HAIN PHIR BHI\nAYE MERE DIL KI SADA MERI SAKINA SOJA
english translation text: YOU ARE USED TO SLEEPING ON YOUR FATHER’S CHEST,\nPERHAPS MY LAP IS NOT AS COMFORTABLE,\nBUT STILL MY HEART CALLS OUT, SLEEP O MY SAKINA

arabic text: CHAAR BARSO SE NA ZAHMAT DI KABHI TUNE MUJHE\nAPNI KHIDMAT KA MUJHE AAJ TO MAUKA DE DE\nHOGA AHSAAN TERA MERI SAKINA SOJA
english translation text: YOU HAVE NEVER ASKED ME FOR ANYTHING THESE FOUR YEARS,\nPLEASE GIVE ME THE CHANCE TO SERVE YOU TODAY,\nIT WILL BE AN HONOUR, SLEEP O MY SAKINA

arabic text: QAIDKHANE ME JO A JAYENGE TERE BABA\nKHUD UTHA DUNGI MAI SHANA HILA KAR TERA\nACHHA KUCHH DER ZARA MERI SAKINA SOJA
english translation text: IF YOUR FATHER COMES TO THE PRISON,\nI MYSELF WILL SHAKE YOUR SHOULDER TO WAKE YOU UP,\nNOW FOR A LITTLE WHILE AT LEAST, SLEEP O MY SAKINA

arabic text: MUJHSE DEKHA NAHI JAATA YE TERA DARD-E-JIGAR\nYE BATATE HUE ACHHA TO NAHI LAGTA MAGAR\nAB NA AYENGE CHACHAA MERI SAKINA SOJA
english translation text: IT IS DIFFICULT FOR ME TO SEE YOU IN THIS AGONY,\nIT IS HARD FOR ME TO TELL YOU THAT,\nYOUR UNCLE (ABBAS) WILL NOT COME BACK, SLEEP O MY SAKINA

arabic text: SABIRO KA YE KARINA TO NAHI HAI BIBI\nHAI YE PARDES MADINA TO NAHI HAI BIBI\nKARKE BAS SHUKR-E-KHUDA MERI SAKINA SOJA
english translation text: O MY SAKINA PLEASE BE PATIENT,\nTHIS IS A FOREIGN LAND AND NOT MADINA,\nTHANK ALLAH (SWT), AND SLEEP O MY SAKINA

arabic text: ISS TARAH SOYI TAKALLUM WOH YATEEMA BIBI\nMAA UTHAATI RAHI, UTHI NA SAKINA BIBI\nPHIR NA BANO NE KAHA, MERI SAKINA SO JA
english translation text: THE ORPHAN CHILD SLEPT IN SUCH A WAY THAT,\nHER MOTHER KEPT TRYING, BUT SAKINA NEVER WOKE UP,\nHER MOTHER THEN NEVER SAID, SLEEP O MY SAKINA
